name: CRITICAL WARNING: Taqueria Chile Relleno (Fried Battered Poblano with Waxy Skin & Seeds)
whyItWorks: Whole roasted poblano pepper stuffed with cheese, dipped in fluffy egg batter, deep-fried in vegetable oil, and smothered in tomato sauce. Indigestible waxy pepper skins and stray hot seeds pose acute stricture hazards, while heavy oil triggers dumping.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Never order Chiles Rellenos with active bowel inflammation or strictures.
